expertText:
* = $1500
OldDD00:
.byte 0
OldD018:
.byte 0
OldD016:
.byte 0
OldD011:
.byte 0
.macro BitmapOn
    SEI
    LDA $DD00
    STA OldDD00
    LDA $D018
    STA OldD018
    LDA $D016
    STA OldD016
    LDA $D011
    STA OldD011
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #%00000011
    STA $DD00
    LDA #$18
    STA $D018
    LDA $D016
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D016
    LDA $D011
    ORA #%00100000
    STA $D011
    JSR HiresClearScreen
    JSR ClearColorRam
    CLI
.endm
.macro BitmapOff
    SEI
    LDA OldD016
    STA $D016
    LDA OldD018
    STA $D018
    LDA OldDD00
    STA $DD00
    LDA OldD011
    STA $D011
    CLI
    LDA #$93
    JSR $FFD2
.endm
.macro HiresClearScreen
    LDX #$20
    LDY #$00
    LDA #$00
    STA $FB
    LDA #$20
    STA $FC
    LDA #$00
HcsBmpPage:
    STA ($FB),Y
    INY
    BNE HcsBmpPage
    INC $FC
    DEX
    BNE HcsBmpPage
    LDA #$00
    LDX #$00
HcsScreenBlock:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE HcsScreenBlock
    LDX #$00
HcsScreenTail:
    CPX #$E8
    BEQ HcsDone
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    BNE HcsScreenTail
HcsDone:
.endm
.macro ClearColorRam
    LDA #$00
    LDX #$00
CcrBlock:
    STA $D800,X
    STA $D900,X
    STA $DA00,X
    INX
    BNE CcrBlock
    LDX #$00
CcrTail:
    CPX #$E8
    BEQ CcrDone
    STA $DB00,X
    INX
    BNE CcrTail
CcrDone:
.endm
.macro WaitForKey
    CLI
WaitKeyLoop:
    JSR $FFE4
    BEQ WaitKeyLoop
    SEI
.endm
.macro DbufSetup
    ; Double-buffer init. Call once before main loop.
    ; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap
    ; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1
    ; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.
    LDA #$60
    STA $10
    LDA #$02
    STA $11
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #$03
    STA $DD00
    LDA #$10
    LDX #$00
DbufFillB1:
    STA $4400,X
    STA $4500,X
    STA $4600,X
    INX
    BNE DbufFillB1
    LDX #$00
DbufFillB2:
    STA $4700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE DbufFillB2
.endm
.macro DbufSwap
    ; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.
    ; Call after a complete frame is drawn.
DbufW1:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCC DbufW1
DbufW2:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCS DbufW2
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA $11
    STA $DD00
    LDA $11
    EOR #$01
    STA $11
    LDA $10
    EOR #$40
    STA $10
.endm
; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----
clear_bitmap:
    LDA $10
    STA $FE
    LDA #$00
    STA $FD
    LDX #$1F
    LDY #$00
cb_page:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    BNE cb_page
    INC $FE
    DEX
    BNE cb_page
    LDY #$00
cb_tail:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    CPY #$40
    BNE cb_tail
    RTS

setpixel:
    STA $FB
    STX $FC
    TXA
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    TAX
    LDA row320lo,X
    STA $FD
    LDA row320hi,X
    STA $FE
    LDA $FB
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    STA $05
    LDA #$00
    STA $06
    LDA $05
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    LDA $06
    ADC $FE
    STA $FE
    CLC
    LDA $FE
    ADC $10
    STA $FE
    LDA $FC
    AND #$07
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    BCC sp_ok
    INC $FE
sp_ok:
    LDA $FB
    AND #$07
    TAX
    LDA bitmask,X
    LDY #$00
    ORA ($FD),Y
    STA ($FD),Y
    RTS

draw_line:
    LDA $22
    SEC
    SBC $20
    BCS dl_dx_pos
    EOR #$FF
    CLC
    ADC #$01
    STA $24
    LDA #$FF
    STA $26
    JMP dl_dy_calc
dl_dx_pos:
    STA $24
    LDA #$01
    STA $26
dl_dy_calc:
    LDA $23
    SEC
    SBC $21
    BCS dl_dy_pos
    EOR #$FF
    CLC
    ADC #$01
    STA $25
    LDA #$FF
    STA $27
    JMP dl_pre
dl_dy_pos:
    STA $25
    LDA #$01
    STA $27
dl_pre:
    LDA $24
    ASL
    STA $2A
    LDA $25
    ASL
    STA $2B
    LDA $24
    CMP $25
    BCC dl_y_major
    LDA $2B
    SEC
    SBC $24
    STA $28
    LDA $24
    STA $29
dl_x_loop:
    LDA $20
    LDX $21
    JSR setpixel
    LDA $28
    BMI dl_x_no_y
    BEQ dl_x_no_y
    LDA $21
    CLC
    ADC $27
    STA $21
    LDA $28
    SEC
    SBC $2A
    STA $28
dl_x_no_y:
    LDA $28
    CLC
    ADC $2B
    STA $28
    LDA $20
    CLC
    ADC $26
    STA $20
    DEC $29
    BPL dl_x_loop
    RTS
dl_y_major:
    LDA $2A
    SEC
    SBC $25
    STA $28
    LDA $25
    STA $29
dl_y_loop:
    LDA $20
    LDX $21
    JSR setpixel
    LDA $28
    BMI dl_y_no_x
    BEQ dl_y_no_x
    LDA $20
    CLC
    ADC $26
    STA $20
    LDA $28
    SEC
    SBC $2B
    STA $28
dl_y_no_x:
    LDA $28
    CLC
    ADC $2A
    STA $28
    LDA $21
    CLC
    ADC $27
    STA $21
    DEC $29
    BPL dl_y_loop
    RTS

row320lo:
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00

row320hi:
.byte $00,$01,$02,$03,$05,$06,$07,$08
.byte $0A,$0B,$0C,$0D,$0F,$10,$11,$12
.byte $14,$15,$16,$17,$19,$1A,$1B,$1C
.byte $1E

bitmask:
.byte $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01
.macro DisplayOff
    LDA $D011
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D011
.endm
.macro DisplayOn
    LDA $D011
    ORA #%00010000
    STA $D011
.endm
